text:
joanna_sales: Incoming RFI from PraxisEdge — asks: private deployment option (VPC), customer-managed HSM, and either client-side PII redaction or cryptographic proof that plaintext never leaves their subnet. They want a capability matrix + 2-week POC plan + ballpark pricing by Tue. Can SE/SRE help scope?

kevin_se: Copy. Can you paste the exact clause and RFI link? Need to confirm if deterministic tokenization is required for matching.

joanna_sales: Link: https://praxisedge.example/rfi/praxis-2026.pdf. Excerpt: "All PII must be redacted at collection or remain cryptographically isolated such that vendor cannot access plaintext." POC focus: messaging + attachments + audit trails.

mohit_sre: For BYO-HSM we support KMIP proxy mode or on-prem appliance. KMIP requires mutual-TLS peering and in-VPC unwrapping. Estimate 24-72h once we get CIDRs and admin contact.

kevin_se: I'll draft three rows in the matrix: (A) client SDK tokenization, (B) Private in-customer subnet with HSM proxy, (C) on-prem appliance. Short bullets for tradeoffs: latency, ops burden, compliance checklist.

anya_legal: Note: if PraxisEdge insists on zero vendor key access, contract must reflect on-prem deployment and altered liability. Also confirm whether they accept our SOC2 + pen test report.

kevin_se: POC deliverables for matrix (bullets): demo flow with redaction, 75 rps throughput smoke (1.5KB), sampled signed audit logs proving no cleartext egress, integration runbook + firewall snippet.

mohit_sre: Firewall snippet ready to drop in runbook: ```
# sample peer rules
allow tcp 443 from praxis-admin to redwood-private-proxy:443
allow tcp 10250-10255 from redwood-control to praxis-admin
```

attachments-bot: uploaded "praxis-rfi.pdf" and "capmatrix-praxis-draft.csv" (internal links).

joanna_sales: Actions: Kevin - update capmatrix with A/B/C approaches and pricing placeholders by Mon EOD. Mohit - confirm provisioning ETA + HA notes. Anya - review RFI and flag contract items. I'll schedule a quick security sync Tue 9am PT. :thumbsup:
